dialogue.origin: こんにちは。
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 1分前ですが始めさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a minute early, but would it be all right to start now?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いいたします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: It's a pleasure to meet you, too.

dialogue.origin: ニックネームでも構いませんので何とお呼びさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I ask what I should call you? A nickname is fine.

dialogue.origin: 洋子です
dialogue.content: Yoko.

dialogue.origin: ありがとございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 洋子さん、今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yoko, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 主人の両親と同居の話が出ていて、困っているんです
dialogue.content: There's talk of moving in with my husband's parents, and I'm troubled by it.

dialogue.origin: 夫さまのご両親とのご相談ですね
dialogue.content: I see, so it's about your husband's parents.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 同居のお話が出て困っていらっしゃるのは具体的にどの様な事がお困りでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more specifically what you find troubling about the idea of living together?

dialogue.origin: 正直いうと同居したくありません。
dialogue.content: To be honest, I don't want to live with them.

dialogue.origin: 洋子さんは、ご同居に反対でいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So, you're against the idea of living together.

dialogue.origin: はっきりと嫌とはまだ言えてないんですが、できればしたくないんです
dialogue.content: I haven’t clearly said I’m against it yet, but I’d prefer not to.

dialogue.origin: そうでいらっしゃるのですね夫さんとはどのようなお話までなされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. How far have the discussions with your husband gone?

dialogue.origin: まだ、いつとは言ってないんですが、そろそろ考えて欲しいと言われてます
dialogue.content: He hasn't set a date, but he's told me he wants me to start thinking about it soon.

dialogue.origin: お話的には迫られていらっしゃる感じなのですね
dialogue.content: So it sounds like you're feeling pressured by the conversation.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご兄弟はいらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband have any siblings?

dialogue.origin: 姉がいます
dialogue.content: He has an older sister.

dialogue.origin: そうするとご長男さんになられるわけですね
dialogue.content: So that makes him the eldest son.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか夫さんのご両親との関係性についてお話伺ってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me about your relationship with your husband's parents?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 両親は仙台に住んでいて、私は横浜です
dialogue.content: His parents live in Sendai, and I live in Yokohama.

dialogue.origin: 両親ともにいい人ですが、１年に1回くらいしか会わない関係で
dialogue.content: They are both nice people, but we only see each other about once a year.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そんな関係なのに、両親をこちらに呼んで住むなんてちょっとむりがあるっていうか
dialogue.content: Given that kind of relationship, asking them to move here and live with us feels a bit unrealistic.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.origin: 両親だって、本当に望んでいるかわからないんですよ
dialogue.content: And I'm not even sure if his parents truly want this.

dialogue.origin: でも、主人が長男だし、いずれは面倒みなきゃなんらないんだから
dialogue.content: But my husband says since he's the eldest son, we'll have to take care of them eventually.

dialogue.origin: ご両親のお気持ちは分からず夫さんからのご提案なのですね
dialogue.content: So this is your husband's suggestion, without knowing how his parents feel about it.

dialogue.origin: だったら元気なうちから同居を始めたほうがいいんじゃないかって。
dialogue.content: He says that in that case, it’s better to start living together while they’re still healthy.

dialogue.origin: そうでいらっしゃいましたか
dialogue.content: I see, so that's his reasoning.

dialogue.origin: 交流が年に1度くらいの間柄でいきなりのご同居は戸惑われて無理もないですよね
dialogue.content: It's completely understandable that you'd feel hesitant about suddenly living together when you only see them about once a year.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 悪い人たちじゃないので、嫌だって言えなくて。
dialogue.content: They're not bad people, so I can't bring myself to say I don't want to.

dialogue.origin: 私が悪者になっちゃうので
dialogue.content: It would make me look like the bad guy.

dialogue.origin: ご両親さんとは、関係的に悪くはないが戸惑いが大きい感じでいらしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So, your relationship with his parents isn't bad, but you're feeling a great deal of hesitation.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかそんな気持ちを言えずにお一人で抱え込まれておられたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. You've been holding these feelings inside without being able to voice them.

dialogue.origin: 少ない自分の時間まで奪われそうで
dialogue.content: I feel like what little personal time I have will be taken away.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 洋子さんは、お仕事をなさっていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Yoko, are you currently working?

dialogue.origin: 家で英語を教えています
dialogue.content: I teach English at home.

dialogue.origin: ご自宅でお仕事なさっておいでなのですねそれはかなりお仕事にも影響しますよね
dialogue.content: So you work from home. That would significantly affect your work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね。
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: ご両親のご意思も確認とらぬままお話が進んでしまっては困るところですね
dialogue.content: It would be problematic for things to move forward without confirming his parents' wishes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。でも、両親は息子との同居はすくなからず喜んでいると思います
dialogue.content: That’s true. But I think they would, at least to some extent, be happy to live with their son.

dialogue.origin: そうでいらしゃいますかすくなからずお喜びだと感じられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you feel they would be at least somewhat pleased.

dialogue.origin: はい、でもやっぱり自分の生活のペースを崩すことになるので、それが嫌なんです
dialogue.content: Yes, but it would still disrupt the pace of my own life, and that's what I don't like.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねご自宅のお部屋的にはいかがなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. How is it in terms of space in your home?

dialogue.origin: 主人はリフォームして、2世帯住宅にしようとしています。完全2世帯ではなく、1階と2階で繋がっていて、玄関は一緒です
dialogue.content: My husband wants to renovate and make it a a two-family home. Not completely separate, but connected between the first and second floors with a shared entrance.

dialogue.origin: そこまで具体的に夫さまは考えていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So your husband has already thought it through that specifically.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: He has.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり避けられないですよね
dialogue.content: I guess it's unavoidable, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: でも、いやいや暮らすのはしんどいですよね。
dialogue.content: But living together grudgingly would be so difficult.

dialogue.origin: 夫さまの気持ちや、ご両親のお気持ち、スペース的な事を考えると、洋子さんも本音が言いにくく追い詰まっておられますよね
dialogue.content: Considering your husband's feelings, his parents' feelings, and the physical space, it sounds like you feel cornered and unable to express your true feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたらいいか・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't know what to do...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね自分の時間も奪われそうで、ペースも乱れイヤイヤな気持ちでは暮らせないですよね
dialogue.content: I understand. It's hard to imagine living unhappily, feeling like your personal time is being taken and your routine is being disrupted.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんとはご結婚なさってどのくらいなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been married?

dialogue.origin: １５年です
dialogue.content: Fifteen years.

dialogue.origin: 15年寄り添われて来られたのですね差し支えなければお子様はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: You've been together for 15 years. If you don't mind me asking, do you have any children?

dialogue.origin: こどもはいません
dialogue.content: No, we don't have children.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかでは同居となると大人だけの住居になられる訳ですね
dialogue.content: I see. So if you were to live together, it would be an adults-only household.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんとのご関係性についてもう少しお話聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about your relationship with your husband?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Sure.

dialogue.origin: ご結婚なさるのに夫さんのどこに魅力をかんじておられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What attracted you to your husband when you got married?

dialogue.origin: えーっと、趣味が合うところですかね・・
dialogue.content: Um, I’d say we share similar interests...

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねお話は良くされる方ですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you two talk a lot?

dialogue.origin: 今は忙しくて、前ほど話す時間がありません。
dialogue.content: We're busy now, so we don't have as much time to talk as we used to.

dialogue.origin: お忙しくなる前は良く話されていたのですね
dialogue.content: So you used to talk a lot before you got busy.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。7、８年前までは話す時間もありました
dialogue.content: Yes. Up until about seven or eight years ago, we had time to talk.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかご自宅で英語教室をなさるとはかなり洋子さんの努力あっての事だと思うのですが
dialogue.content: I see. Running an English class at home must have taken a lot of effort on your part.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんはご理解なさってくださったのですね
dialogue.content: And your husband was understanding of that?

dialogue.origin: はい、理解してくれています
dialogue.content: Yes, he is understanding.

dialogue.origin: 仲が悪いわけでもないけれど、年に1度しか交流のないご両親さまとのご同居を具体的な構想の中、洋子さんの本音が置いていきぼりになってる状態ですよね？
dialogue.content: So it's not that you're on bad terms, but with this concrete plan to live with his parents whom you only see once a year, your true feelings are being left behind, is that right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。主人
dialogue.content: Yes. My husband...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 主人の意見は聞いていますが、私の気持ちはあまり話せていない状況です
dialogue.content: I've listened to my husband's opinion, but I haven't really been able to talk about my own feelings.

dialogue.origin: 本音を言ってしまったら悪者になってしまう気がして言えずに我慢なさっておられたのですね
dialogue.content: You've been holding back, feeling that if you spoke your true feelings, you'd be seen as the bad guy.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。忙しさに流されているのもあるし、本音を言って気まずくなるのも面倒な感じで避けていたのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Yes. I’ve been swept up by how busy things are, and maybe I’ve been avoiding the awkwardness of saying how I really feel.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかお辛い思いを抱えながらいらしたわけですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you've been carrying this painful burden.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話を伺わさせて頂き、
dialogue.content: From what I've heard so far,

dialogue.origin: 自分の気持ちを伝えていないことで、自分自身にもモヤモヤしてたのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Maybe I was feeling conflicted myself because I wasn't communicating my own feelings.

dialogue.origin: ご自身の中のモヤモヤと思われてこられたのですね
dialogue.content: So you've been feeling that internal conflict.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは、洋子さんの積み上げてきた努力をしっかり理解なさる方とお見受けします今、洋子さんが感じているご不安を少しづつでもお伝えしてもいいのかな。と思うのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: From what you've said, your husband seems like someone who understands the effort you've put into your work. I wonder if it might be okay to start sharing, even little by little, the anxieties you're feeling now. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。やはりきちんと伝えて、話さなきゃダメですね。
dialogue.content: You're right. I really need to communicate properly and talk to him.

dialogue.origin: とても勇気のいる事とは思いますが、いきなり反対。という事ではなくご不安なお気持ちだけでもお伝え出来たら良いかと感じます
dialogue.content: I know it takes a lot of courage, but perhaps instead of saying a flat 'no' right away, you could start by just conveying your feelings of anxiety.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。そう思います
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. I think so too.

dialogue.origin: 7.8年、ゆっくりお話出来なかったとお伺いしましたがこれを機に少し言語化できるとよいですよね
dialogue.content: You mentioned you haven't been able to talk properly for seven or eight years. Maybe this could be an opportunity to put some of your feelings into words.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。忙しさに逃げてばかりいないで、もっと会話を増やすようにしてみます
dialogue.content: You're right. Instead of just using busyness as an escape, I'll try to have more conversations.

dialogue.origin: はい！是非お時間つくってお話ししてみてください我慢ばかりしないでくださいね
dialogue.content: Yes! Please try to make time to talk. Don't just keep holding it in.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうします
dialogue.content: Yes, I will.

dialogue.origin: はいご同居するにせよしないにせよ、洋子さんご夫妻が暖かい家庭づくりが出来る事を願っております
dialogue.content: Yes. Whether you decide to live with them or not, I hope that you and your husband can build a warm home together.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: では、一歩ふみだしてみてくださいね！
dialogue.content: Well then, please try to take that first step!

dialogue.origin: はい、がんばってみます！
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll do my best!

dialogue.origin: はい！応援しております今日は以上となりますが言い残したことなどありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes! I'll be cheering for you. That's all for today, but is there anything else you'd like to say?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、大丈夫です。自分でもどうしていいかはっきりわからなくて、モヤモヤしていたのが、ちゃんと自分の気持ちを伝えていないことだと気がつきました。
dialogue.content: No, I'm okay. I wasn't sure what to do and was feeling so conflicted, but I've realized it's because I wasn't properly communicating my own feelings.

dialogue.origin: 聞いていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、良かったです！では、洋子さご夫妻に幸多き事を願ってます！また、何かありましたらご相談にきてくださいね
dialogue.content: I see, I'm glad to hear that! Well, I wish you and your husband all the best. Please come back anytime if something else comes up.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話してくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for speaking with me today.

dialogue.origin: (お時間少しオーバーしてしまいましたがお付き合いくださりありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (We ran a little over time; thank you for staying with me.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.origin: (今日も良き勉強させていただけました。また、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (This was a good learning experience today. I hope to see you again.)

dialogue.origin: （私も勉強になりました。またよろしくおねがいいたします）
dialogue.content: (It was a learning experience for me too. I look forward to next time.)

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。では、終了ボタン押させていただきますね)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I’ll press the end button now.)

dialogue.origin: （はい）
dialogue.content: (Okay.)

dialogue.origin: ではでは！
dialogue.content: Alright then!

topic.sub: 同居に関する意見の不一致
